sermon.title: Godliness Equals Success 11/03/2019
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: Pastor David G. Kincer teaches that godliness equals success, profitable for this life and the life to come. Paul’s encounter with eternal life changed everything he gloried in. Eternal life is shown by loving God and neighbor like the good Samaritan, loving at home, and offering spiritual sacrifices of praise as God’s temple, without fear of persecution.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear.
